Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class BreadthFirstSearch

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.BreadthFirstSearch
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
Direct Known Subclasses:
UnusedElementSearch
public class BreadthFirstSearch extends Object implements edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
A task that performs a breadth-first search of a story graph, starting at node 0, and labeling each node based on the order in which it was visited by the search.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • getOrder

      public Long getOrder(edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Node node)
      Returns the order the given nodes was visited during the search, or null if the node was not visited. The first node visited will have order 0, the second order 1, etc. During search, nodes which have been added to the queue to be visited later, but not yet visited, may have a value of Long.MAX_VALUE; however, no nodes would have this value after the search is complete.
      Parameters:
      node - the node whose order number is desired
      Returns:
      the order the node was visited during the search

    • visit

      protected void visit(edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Node node)
      This method is called when a node is visited during the search. By default, it sets the order number for the node visits all of the node's temporal and epistemic edges. By default, this method will be called at most once per node.
      Parameters:
      node - the node to visit

    • visit

      protected void visit(edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.TemporalEdge temporal)
      This method is called when a temporal edge is visited during the search. By default, if the edge's head is unvisited, its order number will be marked as Long.MAX_VALUE and the node will be queued to be visited later. By default, this method will be called at most once per temporal edge.
      Parameters:
      temporal - the temporal edge to visit

    • visit

      protected void visit(edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.EpistemicEdge epistemic)
      This method is called when an epistemic edge is visited during the search. By default, if the edge's head is unvisited, its order number will be marked as Long.MAX_VALUE and the node will be queued to be visited later. By default, this method will be called at most once per epistemic edge.
      Parameters:
      epistemic - the epistemic edge to visit
